requirements.result: Real native item/icon/check/submenu tree includes Open, New note, clipboard download/history, Island, Mode, Widgets, Pins, capture pause, Settings, updates and Quit.
Numbered pins are ordered by slot, bound to stable IDs, disabled when unavailable, refreshed after rename/reorder/removal; a validated owned pin action is recorded without a shell launch.
Show island, fullscreen/maximised preferences, shapes and monitor choices persist; all three display modes retain one checked native item and their native presentation requests.
Settings and native Island/Widgets settings actions open the real dedicated window; page intents are retained across a cold renderer.
Nab/Notes/Clipboard/Files share the header; Notes reuses capture, cards, filters and Tack status. Files is persisted and restored after process restart.

Search, All/Text/Links/Images/Files/Pinned, original payload copy/pin/delete, adaptive context actions, visible errors and busy/focus behavior are exercised. Number keys in a search field remain text.
Independent capture pause stops watcher history and automatic URL detection, fails closed on preferences errors and survives restart. Existing pause-auto-detect still stores history.

The main window is authorized for Shelf commands; other island callers retain active-surface authorization. Drag permissions are scoped to main/settings; OS clipboard effects stay blocked in acceptance.

Header search filters Shelf and Pins, restores header focus on Escape and preserves an open review. Owned native drops add to Shelf and move to a folder pin; Undo restores original bytes and a tab remount does not replay the consumed drop.
Original Figma SVGs remain local and unchanged; native menu PNGs are intrinsic-size lossless rasterizations. Every captured static asset retains its original effective dimensions.
Frontend/site, format, strict default/spike Clippy, serial Rust tests, release embedding, exact repeats and whole-document axe pass in owned contexts. Failures, raw logs and PNGs remain.

notAutomated: Windows native menu/Explorer pixel appearance, actual clipboard/global keys/cursor or drag-out into another app, live updater network effects, external accounts and installer/signing are not executed. Native menu objects/actions, drag plans, owned HWND drop targets and file move/Undo are verified.
Other platforms/hardware/DPI and a fresh normal idle budget remain V7 work.
